Start with the application

Where do you need the answer?

The right instrument starts with the material, measurement environment and analytical question. Antech helps you connect those requirements to an appropriate Bruker platform.

01 · LABORATORY

Confident routine analysis

Explore FT-NIR for quality control, sample composition and method development with MPA III and TANGO II.

02 · PRODUCTION

Closer to the process

Consider BEAM and MATRIX-F II when measurement needs to move from isolated samples toward process monitoring.

03 · POINT OF NEED

Take analysis with you

Use portable FT-IR to bring material identification and chemical analysis to the field, warehouse or production area.

Explore the core range

Four platforms. Different strengths.

Laboratory flexibility, straightforward routine testing, contactless process analysis and portable FT-IR. Start with the platform that fits how you work.

FT-NIR · LABORATORY FLEXIBILITY

MPA III

One platform. Multiple sample types.

A multi-purpose FT-NIR analyser for liquids, semi-solids, solids, powders and tablets. Choose sampling accessories around your laboratory workflow.

  • Sample compartment, integrating sphere and fibre-optic options
  • Routine quality control and method development
  • Flexible sampling for changing analytical needs
Download MPA III flyer (PDF) ↗
FT-NIR · ROUTINE QUALITY CONTROL

TANGO II

Make routine analysis straightforward.

An intuitive FT-NIR platform designed to make routine measurements accessible. Configurations support liquid or solid and semi-solid samples.

  • Guided operation for different user experience levels
  • Measurement through glass containers
  • Minimal sample preparation for routine workflows
Download TANGO II brochure (PDF) ↗
FT-NIR · PROCESS MONITORING

BEAM

Understand the process as it happens.

A dedicated single-point FT-NIR spectrometer for contactless, real-time measurement of solids and semi-solids in production.

  • Installation over conveyors, hoppers or pipelines
  • Direct monitoring close to the process
  • Application-led integration into production workflows
Download BEAM brochure (PDF) ↗
FT-IR · PORTABLE ANALYSIS

MOBILE-IR II

Bring the laboratory to the sample.

Portable FT-IR with laboratory-grade spectral performance for analysis in the field, warehouse or production environment.

  • Portable chemical identification and analysis
  • Take measurements where the sample is located
  • Support for field and point-of-need workflows
Request the MOBILE-IR II brochure by email

Sampling configurations, calibrations and suitability depend on the application. Discuss your requirements with Antech before selecting a system.
